name: Teen Volunteers at Gail Borden Public Library
what_you_do: Help with library events, refresh library spaces and prepare crafts for programs. Listed sessions include Cleaning the Classics, Knitting for a Cause and Crafting for the Community.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 6 to 12. Bring an ID (school ID, driver's license or library card).
duration: Short sessions, about 1 hour each; you pick the ones you want
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A teen volunteer orientation is listed for Sunday, Oct 18, 1:00 to 1:30 PM at the Main Library Conference Room (the page does not print the year; Oct 18 is a Sunday in 2026).
how_to_apply: 1) Fill out the online teen volunteer application. 2) Register for a one-time Teen Volunteer Orientation. 3) Sign up for open sessions on the teen volunteer calendar. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead.
notes: Grade 6 is under 13, so younger readers should ask about their grade. The library's Elgin Teens page also describes Studio 270, a high school teen space at 270 N. Grove Ave. (homework help, college readiness, job hunting help; phone 847-695-7577), but parts of that page look out of date, so call first. The volunteer page lists a contact email that is hidden in the page text; use the library's Contact Us page.
